task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the cream cheese block beside the bowl.
Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the cream cheese block beside the bottle.
Approach the cream cheese block on the table, bringing the open gripper down from above.
Approach the cream cheese block from above, bringing the open gripper down over the blue package.
Grasp the cream cheese block from the table and lift it up toward the bowl.
Lift the cream cheese up off the table, away from the bowl.
Carry the cream cheese over the table toward the bowl.
Lower the cream cheese down onto the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the empty gripper upward.
Hold the gripper above the bowl containing the cream cheese.
